This is a sample draft. It is not a published post, so it does not appear on the blog, the subscribe page, the sitemap, or the RSS feed. It lives only here, under the drafts area, where I can preview how a post looks before it goes live.

<PostSubscribe />

If you have found this page, there is nothing to read yet. It is a placeholder that keeps the drafts view working while there is no real work in progress. When a genuine draft comes along, this one can go.

## A sample section

The fixture carries one of each heading level so the post body's heading styles stay exercised. Both levels must render with their own type scale, not fall through to the preflight reset.

### A sample subsection

A subsection sits a level below the section above it, and must read as subordinate to it rather than level with it.
